title: Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2018
ACT IV OF 2018
SHAHDADPUR INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2011
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 2nd January, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-31/2017,
dated 2.1.2018.---The Shahdadpur
Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd November, 2017 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 26th December, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Shahdadpur
Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2011 in the matter hereinafter appearing.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act,
2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

3. Amendment
of section 8 of Sindh Act No. XI of 2011.---In the said Act, in section 8, for subsection (1), the following shall
be substituted.-
"(1)
The general direction and administration of the Institute and its affairs shall
vest in the Board consisting of the following:
(i)
Minister Health or if
there is no Minister Health, Member of Cabinet nominated by the Chief
Minister.
Chairman
(ii)
Member of Provincial
Assembly from the Constituency where the Institute is located.
Member
(iii)
Secretary Health
Member
(iv)
Commissioner of the
Division
Member
(v)
A professional having
substantial contribution to the field of Medical Sciences recognized
nationally and internationally (nominated by the Chief Minister)
Member
(vi)
One reputed citizen
from adjacent area of Sanghar involved in philanthropy activities (nominated
by the Chief Minister)
Member
(vii)
Chairman District
Council Sanghar
Member
(viii)
One nominee of
Academic Council
Member
(ix)
Director of the
Institute
Member/ Secretary
